updates.note: Management lowered FY26 revenue guidance to INR 4,100 crores (INR 44 billion / INR 4,100 crores mentioned in transcript).
updates.quote: last year also, we have guided INR3,000 crores of revenue and end up INR2,700 crores. And in the beginning of the year, we guided at INR4,400 crores, now we are targeting INR4,100 crores.

updates.note: Management states the OSAT facility at Sanand is now operational.
updates.quote: The OSAT facility at Sanand is now operational and steadily ramping up.

updates.note: Mentioned that the PCB HDI multilayer PCB facility is coming up at Chennai.
updates.quote: The new PCB HDI multilayer PCB facility coming up at Chennai gives us a strategic advantage.

updates.note: Working capital target revised to 70-85 days from sub-70 days.
updates.quote: So typically, what we expect is about between 70 to 85 days. Last year, it was 85 days.

new_promises.statement: Achieve $1 billion in consolidated revenue by fiscal 2028.
new_promises.quote: we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that because for us, from our bare board, from our OSAT, additional buildings are going to take place.
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
